title: chrysanthemum japonicum
intro: Chrysanthemum japonicum, commonly known as the Japanese chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family and is native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its flowers are rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum japonicum include reducing fever, alleviating headaches and respiratory issues, and providing relief from stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to regulate the autonomic nervous system, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting overall well-being.
